title: eludite.debug.sessions output
description: The live debugging sessions in the order they started (the status bar names them, the active one first). A session that ended is no longer listed.

active.description: The active session's id (absent when no session runs).

id.description: The session's id: 1, 2, ... in the order sessions started, never reused while Eludite runs. Pass it as `session` to any eludite.debug.* command.

name.description: The project's name (its project file or Cargo package without the extension), or the attached process's name.

mode.description: As `mode` in eludite.debug.state, for this session.

active.description: The active session: the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and commands without `session` act on.

generation.description: The session's generation (unique across sessions); events and answers of an older one are dropped.

stop.description: The session's stop counter: quote it as `stop` with `session` to have a command refused if this session moved on.

process_id.description: The debuggee's process id, once known.

project.description: The project file (a Cargo package's Cargo.toml); for an attached session, the process's name.

attached.description: The session attached to a running process.

agents_allowed.description: Whether agents may drive this session (Allow Agents to Drive is per session).

stopped.description: In break mode: why it stopped (`breakpoint`, `step`, `exception`, `pause`, ...).
